fact: On 8 April 2024 the finance ministry and UNDP signed a financing agreement of over one billion CFA francs for phase 2 of digitalisation, which opens a new work stream, an E-cadastre to collect land taxes.
title: Centrafrique : le PNUD accorde plus d'un milliard FCFA au gouvernement pour la phase 2 de digitalisation de l'administration publique
